newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grain futures drift lower on currency.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grain futures drift lower on currency.

text.p: Gains by sterling against other European currencies weighed on LIFFE wheat and barley futures on Monday.
Slow down in demand on the physical market was another contributing factor.
Wheat closed 0.80 to 0.50 stg down after trading 355 lots.
Most traded May closed at 95.50 stg, 0.70 stg down after trading 176 lots.
Barley finished 0.50 to 0.25 stg down on a turnover of 60 lots.
The most traded positions was Nov which closed at 92.90 stg after trading 30 lots.
